title: Reflexivity of guarded reachability
statement: For any natural numbers $m,d$, type $\Lambda$, register program $A : \Lambda \to \mathrm{Ins}(m,d,\Lambda)$, oracle $O : \mathrm{Fin}(d) \to \{0,1\}^* \to \{0,1\}$, input bit string $x$, predicate $G$ on configurations, and configuration $a$, there is a time $T$ such that the run from $a$ is at $a$ after $T$ steps and $G$ holds at every configuration at each time $t<T$.
